answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 19540 Country: India Title: I am having Home loan and monthly bank gets its EMI through my salary. my question is if i have money to perform Hajj can i perform hajj ? is there any any requirement that until you complete your loan you can't do Hajj ? Question: I am having Home loan and monthly bank gets its EMI through my salary. my question is if i have money to perform Hajj can i perform hajj ? is there any any requirement that until you complete your loan you can't do Hajj ? Answer ID: 19540 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 188/33/TL=1431) You can perform hajj if you can afford it, your hajj shall be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
